verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud ships built-in AI and Agentforce, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an opt-out, a zero-data-retention policy, or any no-training guarantee for customer data. The ABAC access-control evidence (salesforce-docs-32) governs who can see data, not whether it is used for model training, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
